title: Strait of Juan de Fuca — Freshwater Bay / Port Angeles approaches
product: Official NOAA ENC data portrayed by NOAA ECDIS Display Service

image.encoding: PNG as data URL inside JSON; preserves original response bytes

renderer: Meridian-derived MapLibre GL 4.7.1 image source. S-57 to S-52 portrayal is performed by NOAA, not by a local S-57 parser.
depthUnits: metres (NOAA service display default verified via parameters endpoint)
visibleCellVerification: NOAA identifyDatasets with mapextent=-13771000,6120000,-13741000,6140000, insr=102100, imagedisplay=1800,1200,96 returned visible=true for these two cells; harbour and other overlapping cells were visible=false.
limitations: Fixed regional snapshot; zooming does not acquire additional detail.
Outside-image area is explicitly no packaged coverage.
No certified ECDIS or chart-carriage claim.
No depth query, safe-water geometry or computed time-to-margin.
Navigation observations and controls remain illustrative browser-local models.
